title: Is the post-gate price null a property of the signal or of the learner? The run-to-run innovation handed directly to the ladder's own learner, out of sample
question: phase85's post-gate cell REPLACES the pre-gate field, and an axis-aligned tree cannot form the difference of two columns. This feeds the difference itself as extra columns and measures what the learner does with it.

part1_row_set.why: adding columns to the design must not move a single row; a duplicating join would show up here as a row-count change

part4_full_panel_bit_reproduction.why: a full-panel, all-folds bit reproduction of phase85's headline cell through this script's harness, obtained as a by-product of an all-missing feature column

gate_a_harness.consequence_if_fail: Abort the price reading: a refit of phase85's own headline cell on phase85's own folds that does not reproduce means any delta measured against it mixes the added columns with an unexplained harness difference.

part3_statistics_path.why: recomputing phase85's OWN published gate-timing contrast from its parquet through this script's aggregation, subset and bootstrap. If this does not land on +0.0026 over 732 days then the pipeline reporting the innovation contrast is not the pipeline that produced the paper's number.

gate_b_physical_positive_control.consequence_if_fail: UNDETERMINED-CONSTRUCTION-BROKEN: the innovation is by construction the update to the weather field, so a physical arm that does not improve means the construction is wrong and NO price branch may be read.

treated_cell_predictions_differ.why: a null from a treatment that never reached the model is not the null this phase is testing for

gate_c_innovation_non_degenerate.consequence_if_fail: UNDETERMINED: a numerically zero innovation means the two GPV caches hold the same data, which is a data defect, not a finding about price.

gate_d_price.statistic: pooled daily improvement of pre_plus_wx_innov minus that of msm_d2_12z_cw, on phase85's CW-complete subset, with phase85's 7-day circular block bootstrap (10000 draws) and HLN-DM at L=3 and L=9 -- i.e. phase85's own gate-timing construction with the cell swapped

tick.rationale: one JEPX price tick, the market's own price granularity; a smallness benchmark for the POOLED MEAN absolute error only -- mean-level equivalence does not bound individual slot forecast differences (phase75 tested the decision scale separately and found non-equivalence at the reviewer's margins)

relevance.rationale: 20% of the CW pre-gate headline improvement, fixed as a FORMULA in the phase85 precommit before estimation; SECONDARY because it is anchored on an estimate

equivalence_detail.smallest_margin_note: smallest symmetric margin whose interval contains the 90% CI; a DESCRIPTIVE by-product, NOT a pre-committed margin

gate_e_representation.reading: positive means the DIFFERENCED basis extracts more than the raw-union basis, i.e. part of the ladder's post-gate null was a representation artefact

pre_plus_wx_innov.note: per-area DM tests are DESCRIPTIVE here; the pre-registered statistic is the pooled one

pre_plus_pv_innov.note: per-area DM tests are DESCRIPTIVE here; the pre-registered statistic is the pooled one

controls_thinned_panel.note: a matched subsample of the SAME folds (phase85's schedule with STEP widened to 3 days); the primary and reference contrasts are recomputed on exactly these days so every number in this block is like for like

pre_plus_noise.note: per-area DM tests are DESCRIPTIVE here; the pre-registered statistic is the pooled one

pre_plus_post_raw.note: per-area DM tests are DESCRIPTIVE here; the pre-registered statistic is the pooled one

pv_cell_daylight_sub_panel_descriptive.note: DESCRIPTIVE sub-panel, not pre-registered: the rows where Delta-PV-hat is an observed number rather than a structural night zero or a NaN

hours_only_all_nine_areas.restriction: daylight hours only, all nine areas

decomposition_of_the_restriction.why: the headline sub-panel restricts hours AND areas at once; printing each restriction alone shows which one carries the difference

training_support.note: rows outside this range enter XGBoost as missing on the innovation columns, exactly as phase85's own CW tier columns do on days a cache lacks

pv_innov.note: night_zero is a structural zero (Delta-PV-hat of a PV quantity at night); missing is NaN and is never silently zero

build_diagnostics_design_frame.note: nulls are the pre-CW-cache training period; they enter XGBoost as missing, as phase85's own CW columns do. Every SCORED row is CW-complete, so the innovation is finite on every row the contrast is measured on -- see innovation_magnitude_and_nulls_on_scored_rows.

feature_importance_descriptive.note: DESCRIPTIVE, from an earlier session of the committed phase102 module: total_gain share of the four innovation columns in the pre_plus_wx_innov cell, on ten real folds per area. It says the learner DOES split on them, which is what makes a null a statement about the signal rather than about the feature reaching the model.

design.note: DESCRIPTIVE, not pre-registered. Ten of the panel's real test days per area; each fit is bit-identical to phase85's `_fit` on the same fold (asserted).

estimator.model: phase85's XGBRegressor verbatim: n_estimators=300, max_depth=4, learning_rate=0.05, random_state=2026, n_jobs=4, tree_method=hist
estimator.reuse: phase85's panel, fold schedule (expanding window, STEP=1d for the question, VAL_WINDOW=14d, INITIAL_TRAIN_END=2024-07-18), design matrix, CW-complete subset, per-day aggregation, 7-day circular block bootstrap and HLN-DM are IMPORTED AND CALLED, not reimplemented. The innovation construction and the _design/_fit rebinding are the committed phase102 module's; the rebinding is asserted in force, asserted called for exactly the requested areas, and demonstrated by GATE A.
estimator.physical: expanding-window OLS through the origin on phase89's row set, target, daylight window, per-area stamp convention and burn-in (min_train_rows=200); day t fitted on days strictly before t. k=1 is phase89's own model.
